description: Return exposed/converted visitors and comparisons per flag arm for visitors the random split assigned since the split last changed (assignmentChangedAt). Fisher when any expected cell is below 5, else a two-proportion z-test; significance uses Holm-adjusted p-values and minimumVisitorsPerArm. Boolean flags are not randomized and never significant.

controlArm.description: Arm to compare against. Defaults to a variant named control, then false for boolean and rollout flags, then the first variant.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: get_experiment_results

outputSchema.description: flagKey and flagType identify the experiment; goal identifies its conversion goal; startDate/endDate bound the measurement. assignmentChangedAt, when set, is the instant the variants or split last changed; exposures before it are not counted. arms contains each variant's exposed and converted visitor counts, conversionRate percent, isControl, and nullable comparison against controlArm. comparison reports absoluteDifference, relativeLift, approximate interval bounds ciLow/ciHigh (using the Holm step threshold for z-tests), raw pValue, adjustedPValue (Holm-corrected across the comparisons with the control), testMethod and significant (adjustedPValue < 0.05). randomized is false for boolean flags, whose On/Off groups are chosen by targeting, so nothing is significant. minimumVisitorsPerArm gates significance; mixedExposureVisitors counts excluded visitors who saw multiple arms; notRandomizedVisitors counts excluded visitors whose version targeting chose rather than the random split. hint explains missing usable exposures.

title: Get experiment results
